mapper.sql: question_id , slide_id, image_id, project_id, image_code, json_name, size, fitting_interval, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time
mapper.select:
select p.project_name projectName, tt.topic_name topicName, qb.question_id questionId, qb.image_code imageCode, qb.size as size, qb.json_name jsonName, o.organization_name organizationName, qb.create_time createTime from tb_question_bank qb left join tb_slide s on qb.slide_id = s.slide_id left join tb_project p on qb.project_id = p.project_id left join tb_topic tt on qb.topic_id = tt.topic_id left join sys_organization o on qb.organization_id = o.organization_id
and p.project_name like CONCAT('%',#{projectName},'%')
and qb.image_code like CONCAT('%',#{imageCode},'%')
and tt.topic_name like CONCAT('%',#{topicName},'%')
and o.organization_name like CONCAT('%',#{organizationName},'%')
and qb.organization_id =#{organizationId}
order by qb.create_time desc

select distinct qb.project_id projectId, p.project_name projectName from tb_question_bank qb left join tb_project p on qb.project_id = p.project_id
and qb.organization_id = #{organizationId}
